title: Property Tax Assessment Anomaly Detection

blueprintSignals.name: Assessment ratio
blueprintSignals.definition: assessed value divided by the adjusted sale price for recent sales
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Few sales in an area give noisy ratios

blueprintSignals.name: Neighbourhood ratio
blueprintSignals.definition: median ratio of comparable properties in the same neighbourhood

blueprintSignals.name: Unrecorded changes
blueprintSignals.definition: building permits and aerial change detections not reflected in the record

blueprintSignals.name: Sale price gap
blueprintSignals.definition: difference between the last sale price and the current assessment, adjusted for market movement

label: For "Property Tax Assessment Anomaly Detection": Find properties whose assessed value is far from their expected market value so assessors fix inequity and appeal risk. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Sales selection, since sales are not a random sample of properties.
